In case of Joint Life Annuity, the Primary Annuitant will be the primary person entitled to receive the Annuity 
Benefits . In the event of death of the Primary Annuitant, the Secondary Annuitant will be entitled to receive 
the annuities.  However, the annuity payments will continue for as long as either of the annuitant is alive and
